name: hash-snapshot-reuse-syndrome-preflight
title: Reuse command-local hash snapshots across DONE and review gates
description: Introduce a narrow command-local freshness snapshot so DONE and review assurance gates can reuse one authoritative HEAD/material/story-files binding within the same command execution. This is not a global cache and must not weaken stale-evidence detection; it only removes duplicate whole-tree hash recomputation after the binding has already been captured for the same git state.

events.reason: Discarding half-initialized duplicate story shell: checklist artifact is missing, so checklist_add cannot proceed; recreating cleanly with forceNew for the approved M1 milestone.
